metrics.partVolumeScope: Visible static closed mesh pairs, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes intra-mesh intersections, motion, open surfaces and usable passage space. Positive overlap may be intentional.
metrics.openSurfaceScope: Visible static open surfaces sampled at their vertices against visible static closed solids, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes open-vs-open pairs, motion, and any solid thinner than the sampled surface's facet spacing. Penetration within the contact tolerance is treated as intended contact, and penetration beyond it may still be intentional, as a fitting socketed into a shell is.

metrics.instanceabilitySummary: D (informational, not a QA verdict), set by 8 distinct materials (D at 7-12). Also: 1 transparent material (lowers only A/B to C); 34 geometries; 164 draw calls. Optional advice, not a requirement: merging trim-graphite + tool-panel-grey + stainless + accent-clean and 3 more (differ in baseColorFactor, emissiveFactor, metallicFactor, roughnessFactor) would leave 2 materials (B at 2-3; other factors give C).
